name: io.github.darylirl/alphalens-mcp-server
title: AlphaLens
description: Read-only MCP tools over the AlphaLens public API: Ledger, cohort positioning, cohort.

environmentVariables.name: ALPHALENS_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the AlphaLens deployment to read. Defaults to https://alphalens-taupe.vercel.app.

io.github.darylirl/alphalens.note: No `packages` entry yet: this server is run from source (`node mcp-service/index.mjs`) or from the Dockerfile in this directory. A packages entry is added here when a published npm or OCI artifact exists to point at — an identifier that resolves to nothing would be a claim we cannot back.
